I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The official date Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands to him is Monday, November 3, 2025, so that's the date to put in the CRM.

- **Sources:** Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday 11/2/2025 says "Account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." Bettina's Dec 8 cutover recap note also gives November 3 as the official handoff. Both are public files, and I didn't use any private messages.
- **Day-to-day handoff:** Bettina's note says she ran the account day to day until Nov 21 and Kwame fully took over on November 22. I told him to use Nov 22 only if the CRM has a separate field for when he started working it day to day.
